In this module you choose your own topic and carry out a systematic review and meta-analysis in R, from protocol to draft paper. The first six weeks you write and read R code yourself. In week 7 we turn to Claude Code.

## How a week works

1. **Learn the R code.** Work through the lecture script, the concept list and the practice questions, or come to the lecture. Slides and scripts are online before the lecture.
2. **Quiz.** At the start of the next tutorial you take a short paper quiz: you read R code and output from the previous lecture and explain what it does and what it means.
3. **Apply it to your own data** in the tutorial, with the tutor available for questions.
4. **Hand in** before the deadline via the [submission form](../submit.qmd).
